handoff.salientSummary: Implemented F1.4 reports artifact contract: run-scenario.sh emits self-contained artifacts/ bundles, dispatch-swarm.sh includes product+asserts in snapshots with mixed-provider handling and RUN_ID collision detection, apply-scenario.sh is idempotent over helm repo add and cleans tempfiles on SIGTERM, aggregate.sh uses Python csv for proper round-trip.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: 1. run-scenario.sh artifact bundle (VAL-ENGINE-013/014/015, VAL-CROSS-013/014/029): emits artifacts/scenario.yaml, applied-overrides.yaml (helm_values map + raw_manifest_refs seq), fixtures/, manifests/, versions.json, logs/. 2. dispatch-swarm.sh fixes (VAL-ENGINE-031/036/037, VAL-CROSS-028): scenarios-snapshot includes product+asserts; run-meta reflects mixed providers as YAML list; RUN_ID collision detection; sed replaces envsubst for safe substitution. 3. apply-scenario.sh (VAL-ENGINE-032/033): idempotent helm repo add; SIGTERM tempfile cleanup via EXIT+INT+TERM trap. 4. aggregate.sh (VAL-ENGINE-034): Python csv module for commas/newlines/quotes round-trip; Bash 3.2 compatible. 5. 18 new bats test cases.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: End-to-end integration test against a real kind cluster to verify actual artifact file contents at runtime is deferred to milestone scrutiny validation.
